question: Should CodexBar officially support OMP session logs as a pi-compatible local-cost source?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and proof-backed, but accepting a new documented third-party session root is a product and maintenance-contract choice that source review cannot resolve.

options.title: Support OMP sessions
options.body: Merge the scanner and documentation change, with OMP JSONL compatibility becoming part of the local-cost support contract.

options.title: Keep the current source boundary
options.body: Decline the OMP root and retain the existing pi-session scope until there is an explicit support plan.

recommendation.title: Support OMP sessions
recommendation.body: Merge the scanner and documentation change, with OMP JSONL compatibility becoming part of the local-cost support contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR history ties steipete directly to the most recent scanner correctness work and provides the strongest routing signal.
